categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies .github/workflows/ci.yml and CI cache actions to run tests on native macOS arm64 runners.
categories.rationale: Prevents supported-platform breakages by running cross-built binaries on native macOS hardware in CI, directly addressing the gap where platform-specific runtime defects such as #35771 slip through undetected.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' by maintainers and expands CI test coverage for unit and GUI test suites to native macOS arm64.
categories.rationale: Extends test execution to a previously untested target platform configuration, catching realistic platform-specific test regressions before release.
